note: Repair the Spori art studio's overhead projector (it broke during the art demo). Rotate the wire tiles. Lamp, fan and power light are identical loads (resistance 1); the supply is 1 unit: current ≥ 0.75 = bright/full, ≥ 0.2 = dim/slow, otherwise off. Rows list tiles in their SOLVED orientation; the game scrambles them.
legend: Tiles: '.' empty; wire tiles list their open sides (N E S W), e.g. 'WE', 'ES', 'WES'; 'B+N' battery with + on that side and − opposite; 'U:NS:id' bulb; 'S:WE:id' switch. Battery, bulbs and switches are fixed.

levels.title: Get the lamp to light
levels.goal: Make the projector lamp glow brightly.
levels.hint: Make a loop: from + (top of the plug) around through the lamp and back to −.

levels.title: Lamp and fan at full
levels.goal: The lamp and the cooling fan must BOTH run at full power.
levels.hint: Give the lamp and the fan each their own path to both ends of the plug (parallel). In one chain they'd both run weak.

levels.title: A switch for the fan
levels.goal: The lamp stays bright; the switch turns the cooling fan on and off.
levels.hint: Put the switch only on the fan's branch. Flip it (right stick ↑) to test both ways.

levels.title: Dim power light, bright lamp
levels.goal: The power light and the fan's low setting share one path and run DIM; the lamp stays BRIGHT.
levels.hint: Two loads in one chain (series) share the supply and run dim. Route them as one chain up and over.

levels.title: Find the short
levels.goal: The projector keeps blowing its fuse. Find the wire that connects + straight to − and turn it so the lamp lights.
levels.hint: Sparks mean + is wired straight to −. Look for a wire that bridges the top rail and the bottom rail without going through the lamp.
